content.text: Hx woods · hiking · camping - most pts ⍉recall tick bite → sus in Sxtomatic pts in endemic areas
Early localized (3-30 d, typically 7 d after bite)
(red annular lesion w central clearing) · fever · malaise · HA · myalgias · arthralgias
EM: sometimes pruritic · up to 20cm - central clearing over days–wks

EM (pathognomonic): classic round erythematous slightly raised lesion w central clearing (bull's-eye) - often only red macular rash @ bite site that expands to lrg lesion - children may have fever · fatigue · arthralgias
(esp. 7, lasts 2-8wks then resolves) · fatigue · myalgia · HA · occasionally
Bilat facial nerve palsy = pathognomonic for Lyme - myocarditis
chronic demyelinating encephalitis · polyneuritis · memory problems

Lyme arthritis = MC presentation of late Lyme: mono- or oligoarticular · lrg joints (esp knee) - swelling & stiffness · USU afebrile · can bear wt · less pain than inflam or septic arthritis - effusion w.o warmth or erythema - also chronic encephalopathy
Prognosis (children): excellent - ⍉reports of chronic Lyme arthritis - untx → freq recurr of joint pain & swelling in 1st few yrs
ddx septic bact arthritis: more severe pain & restricted motion · ill-appearing - synovial WBC higher (sometimes >50,000 · often >100,000/µL)
ddx pigmented villonodular synovitis (tenosynovial giant cell tumor): abnorm synovial prolif - intermittent pain · swelling · hemarthrosis - XR bone erosion · bloody synovial fluid
: 10-150 WBC/mm3 · <10% segmented neutrophils · ↑ protein · norm glucose
: WBC 20,000-60,000/mm3 & ⊕ Lyme PCR of joint fluid
•synovial WBC in inflam range - ⍉as high as septic arthritis
•joint fluid PCR: ↑false-⊕ rate - ⍉use alone to dx Lyme arthritis
Dx: clin in early localized - serology in later stages
•abx for all stages - doxycycline for early dz & late arthritis - amoxicillin · cefuroxime = alts
•IV ceftriaxone: severe neuro (severe meningitis · encephalitis) or cardio involvement · arthritis ⍉responding to PO abx

Lyme arthritis Tx: PO doxy (or amox/cefuroxime) x28d - Partial response (mild residual swelling) → repeat 2nd 28d PO course - ⍉/minimal response (mod–severe swelling) → IV ceftriaxone x2–4 wk - Persistent despite abx (post-abx arthritis) → rheum: NSAIDs · DMARDs (MTX) ± synovectomy
: transient fever · HA · myalgias after therapy = started
Prophylaxis after tick bite: single-dose doxycycline if Ixodes tick · attached ≥36h (engorged) · started w.in 72h of removal · doxycycline ⍉CI
gram-neg coccobacilli - endemic: NC · OK · AR · TN · MO
vasc inj + clotting factor activation → microhemorrhages & microinfarcts
N · Central & parts of S America - MC rickettsial infect in US - MC in SE & south-central states
common in children but all ages
· myalgia · HA (w photophobia) · V/D · abd pain
classic: fever · HA · rash + hx tick bite - up to 1/3 ⍉report tick bite (⍉felt or hidden by hair/skin folds)
nonspecific early sxs (malaise · arthralgias · N ± V) → misdx common
children: may have severe abd pain
•spreads centripetally - palms/soles involved in later stages
•seen in up to 90% - often absent @ presentation
: conjunctivitis · retinal abnorm (flame hemorrhage · retinal engorgement · arterial occlusion) · confusion · pedal edema (esp children)
fever + rash + hx of tick exposure
•likely if fever + constitutional sxs & from/travel to endemic area w.in 14d · tick bite · outdoor exposure
•dx clinically - start tx w.o waiting for labs - tx w.in 1st 5d of sxs → best outcome
•⍉cx in most labs → confirm w serology · PCR · skin bx stains
thrombocytopenia · ↓ Na · mild leukopenia · proteinuria · mildly abnorm LFTs · hypoalbuminemia · hematuria
indirect fluorescent or latex agglutination Ab
•ALWAYS doxycycline - even in children - short courses approved for all ages (despite dental staining risk <8y)
•chloramphenicol traditionally preferred in preg - now doxycycline universal (even young children & preg)
•chloramphenicol in 3rd TM → gray baby syndrome: abd distention · cyanosis · vasomotor collapse · infant death
mild: outpt w close f/u - severe: Hsp for hemodynamic monitoring & supportive care ± empiric tx for alt dx (meningitis) while awaiting tests
